name: How should homeowners prepare their kitchen before flooring installers arrive?

mainEntity.name: How should homeowners prepare their kitchen before flooring installers arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before installation day, homeowners should clear out the kitchen to protect belongings and streamline work. Start by removing all loose items from the floor, including barstools, trash cans, pet dishes, and rugs. Empty low cabinets or pantry shelves if vibration from heavy demolition might rattle fragile glassware. Clear pathways leading from the exterior entryway to the kitchen so the crew can carry materials, tools, and old debris safely. You will also need a plan for unhooking and moving major appliances like refrigerators and ranges, especially if water lines or gas connections need careful handling before floor removal begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out portable furniture, rugs, and decor, empty lower cabinets holding breakables, clear an entryway path for tools, and arrange for appliances with plumbing or gas lines to be disconnected.
